sf.id as id, sf.name , sf.user_id , sf.state , sf.file_id , sf.master_id, sf.update_time , sf.create_time,sf.if_private
,f.id as f_id, f.name as f_name, f.file_url as f_file_url, f.save_type as f_save_type, f.file_type_index as f_file_type_index ,f.video_long as f_video_long

mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (sf.id)
,sc.id as sc_id, sc.video_id as sc_video_id, sc.sub_id as sc_sub_id, v.id as v_id, v.video_name as v_video_name, v.video_name_index as v_video_name_index, v.file_id as v_file_id, v2.video_source as video_source, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.name_index as s_name_index, s.description as s_description, s.sub_img_id as s_sub_img_id
, COALESCE((select count(id) from gc_user_save_content where folder_id=sf.id and master_id=#{masterId}),0) as videoNum, (select f.id from gc_user_save_content sc left join sys_file f on f.id = sc.file_id where sc.folder_id=sf.id and sc.master_id=#{masterId} order by sc.create_time asc limit 1) as firstVideoFileId from gc_user_save_folder sf left join gc_user_save_content sc on sc.folder_id = sf.id
AND (sc.user_id=#{userId})
AND (sc.user_id=#{userId} or sf.if_private != 1)
left join gc_video v on v.id = sc.video_id left join gc_subject s on s.id= sc.sub_id left join sys_file fs on s.sub_img_id=fs.id left join sys_file f on v.file_id=f.id left join gc_user u on u.id = sf.user_id left join gc_user_info info on info.id = u.info_id left join sys_file uf on info.avatar_file_id = uf.id left join gc_subject sv on sv.id= v.sub_id left join gc_video v2 on v2.file_id = f.id where 1=1
AND sf.user_id=#{userId}
and sf.name like CONCAT('%',#{playListName},'%')
and (sf.if_private != 1 or sf.user_id=#{userId}) and sf.master_id=#{masterId}
AND sf.id in
#{folderId}
AND sf.id not in
#{myFolderId}
order by sf.id DESC, sf.create_time DESC, sc.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT time_bucket, COUNT(gc_user_save_folder.id) OVER (ORDER BY time_bucket) AS value
FROM ( SELECT #{filter.start}::timestamp with time zone AS time_bucket UNION SELECT #{filter.end}::timestamp with time zone ) AS time_bucket
FROM generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval) AS time_bucket
LEFT JOIN gc_user_save_folder ON
create_time >= time_bucket AND create_time < time_bucket + concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval
create_time <= time_bucket
AND master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY time_bucket, gc_user_save_folder.id ORDER BY time_bucket;
